changes.title: Faced With Heat and Wildfires, France Turns to Spain to Learn How to Cope
changes.summary: A French government delegation will travel to its southern neighbor to learn how it copes with long spells of hot weather.

changes.title: More than 80,000 flee forest infernos in France and Spain
changes.summary: Europe's wildfire crisis forced more than 80,000 people to flee for safety Friday, as vacationers boarded boats to escape fires on a French peninsula and Spanish officials ordered mass evacuations in towns near Madrid.

changes.title: Wildfires in France and Spain Drive Tens of Thousands From Their Homes
changes.summary: French officials ordered the evacuation of the Cap Ferret peninsula, a popular holiday destination. Fires west of Madrid were closing in on populated areas.
